about_the_game:
Welcome to a high-stakes quiz where your life is on the line. Answer correctly and you will keep Smiley at bay and live. Answer incorrectly and he may eat you whole. Your knowledge will be tested across several categories, and you will get a choice as to which topic you want to go with. Examples include Anime, Maths, Gaming, History, General Knowledge, Famous Villains, and more. Which one will you choose when survival is at stake?

Rounds consist of several types of questions, including "Spot the odd one out" and "True or False".

As the game progresses, Smiley will get faster, but you'll gain access to cards that will aid you in your task.

This is a true test of knowledge. Good luck!
